resources.string: Is bhasha mein scam detection abhi Beta mein hai aur testing jaari hai.
Regional bhashaon (Beta) mein scam detection ki testing abhi jaari hai.
Protection system dwara pause ho gayi. Re-enable karne ke liye tap karein.
Xiaomi, Samsung aur doosre phones par background protection active rakhein
Device model aur OS version ke mutabiq settings alag ho sakti hain.
Kuch phones me battery saver DUARF ko messages check karne se rok deta hai. Apne brand ke hisaab se steps follow karein.
1. Settings > Apps > Manage Apps > DUARF kholein 2. \'Autostart\' enable karein 3. Battery saver me \'No restrictions\' select karein
1. Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > \'Never sleeping apps\' me DUARF add karein 2. Settings > Apps > DUARF > Battery me \'Unrestricted\' select karein
1. Settings > Apps > App Management > DUARF > Battery usage kholein 2. \'Allow background activity\' aur \'Allow auto-launch\' on karein
1. Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management kholein 2. DUARF select karke \'High background power usage\' choose karein
Aap ise kabhi bhi Settings mein badal sakte hain.
Aap koi bhi bhasha chunein, DUARF har supported bhasha ke messages check karta hai.
Koi code ya PIN mat bataiye
Jawab mat dijiye, paise mat bhejiye
Wajah dekhne ke liye phone unlock kijiye. Tab tak koi link mat kholiye.
Koi chetavani ka sanket nahi mila. Phir bhi satark rahein: scam badalte rehte hain.
Paise ya OTP de diye hain?
Turant national cyber helpline par call karein.
Jaanch isi phone par hui. Kuch bhi kahin nahi bheja gaya.
DUARF chetavani: mujhe mila ek message scam lagta hai (%1$s). Iske link mat kholiye aur koi OTP mat bataiye.
Internet ki permission nahi. Kuch bhi is phone se bahar nahi jaata.
Kuch bhi karne se pehle pooch lijiye
Agar paise ya OTP de diye hain
Koi bharosemand vyakti, jise chetavani par kuch karne se pehle call karein. Sirf isi phone par, encrypt karke save hota hai.
10 se 15 ankon ka phone number daalein
